roads.name: Snowmobile ITS 80
words: Properly twisty: 15 curves in 2.8 miles, about 5 a mile.
The curves flow straight into one another.
From 558 to 1,384 ft, with 885 ft of up and down along the way.
Wooded nearly the whole way.
July highs average 79°F.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every road in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 35 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.33 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace.
